app.title: Card Kiosk
app.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

enroll.title: Set up this kiosk
enroll.intro: This device isn't a kiosk yet. An administrator can turn it into one: customers will be able to browse the cards you chose in Administration ▸ Kiosk and put them on a pick list.
enroll.deviceNameHelp: Shown to staff with each pick list, e.g. "Front counter".
enroll.notAdmin: That isn't an administrator's username and password.

exit.title: Exit kiosk mode
exit.body: An administrator's username and password take this device out of kiosk mode. It will need to be set up again to be used as a kiosk.

closed.title: The kiosk is closed
closed.body: Please ask at the counter for help finding cards.

app.noLocations: There's nothing to browse yet. Please ask at the counter.

welcome.title: Find your cards
welcome.body: Browse or search our cards, tap the ones you want, and we'll pull them for you at the counter.
welcome.nameHelp: We'll call this name when your cards are ready.
welcome.nameTaken: Someone is already using "{{name}}". Try adding an initial or a nickname.

browse.startOverConfirm: Start over? Everything on your list will be put back.
browse.search: Search by card name or set
browse.noResults: No cards found. Try a different search.
browse.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please enter your name to start again.

list.title: My pick list
list.empty: Your list is empty. Tap a card to add it.
list.estimate: Prices are estimates; the final price is confirmed at the counter.
list.submitConfirmTitle: Send your list to the counter?
list.submitConfirmBody: We'll start pulling your {{count}} cards. You won't be able to change the list at the kiosk afterwards.

submitted.title: Thanks, {{name}}!
submitted.body_one: Your pick list ({{count}} card) is on its way to the counter. Give your name at the counter to pick it up.
submitted.body_other: Your pick list ({{count}} cards) is on its way to the counter. Give your name at the counter to pick it up.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: Your list will be cleared in {{seconds}} seconds.

queue.title: Kiosk pick lists
queue.empty: No pick lists right now. Customers' lists appear here when they send them from a kiosk.
queue.browsingNote: The customer is still choosing; their cards are held while they browse.
queue.cancelConfirm: Cancel {{name}}'s pick list? Its cards are released for other customers.
queue.printHint: Pull the cards in the order shown, grouped by location.

orderDialog.title: Create order for {{name}}
orderDialog.body: Creates a Manual order with these cards at the prices shown to the customer, then closes the pick list. Finish the sale from Sales ▸ Orders.

settings.title: Customer kiosk
settings.intro: Customers browse the locations below on a kiosk device and put cards on a pick list for staff to pull (Sales ▸ Kiosk). To set up a device, open {{url}} on it and sign in with an administrator account.
settings.enabledHelp: When off, kiosks show a "closed" screen.
settings.locationsHelp: Customers can browse and hold every card in these locations. Copies listed on TCGplayer or eBay, on an open order, or held by another customer aren't offered.
settings.noLocations: No locations yet; customers have nothing to browse.
settings.idleTimeoutHelp: A customer who stops using the kiosk for this long loses their unsent list. Lists sent to the counter never expire.
settings.welcomeMessageHelp: Optional text on the kiosk's welcome screen.
settings.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? The device stops working as a kiosk right away, and its customer's unsent list is cleared.
